statement.zh: Delougaz、Hill & Lloyd《迪亚拉私宅与墓葬》OIP 88（1967）正式刊布哈法杰、阿斯马尔与阿格拉卜私宅/墓葬建筑。
statement.en: Delougaz, Hill & Lloyd Private Houses and Graves in the Diyala Region (OIP 88, 1967) publishes house and grave architecture from Khafajah, Tell Asmar, and Tell Agrab.

editorial.notes: Paraphrased from cited registered sources only.
